endpoints.name: Competitor Keywords
endpoints.description: The keywords named competitors rank for alongside the site, over a range. Requires the site, dates and competitors. Where a competitive gap is actually located, keyword by keyword.

endpoints.name: Group Competitor Keywords
endpoints.description: The same competitor keyword comparison within one group.

endpoints.name: Competitor Visibility Score
endpoints.description: The same visibility measure for named competitors alongside the site, over a range. Requires the site, dates and competitor domains. The comparative view: a site's own score falling while competitors rise means something different from everyone falling together.

endpoints.name: Group Competitor Visibility Score
endpoints.description: The competitor comparison restricted to one keyword group. Useful where a competitor is strong in one product area and absent elsewhere, which the site-wide score averages away.

endpoints.name: Content Performance
endpoints.description: Per-page performance over a range: the traffic, rankings and keywords each page attracts. Requires the site id and dates. The page-centric view, as opposed to the keyword-centric one everything else here offers.

endpoints.name: Devices
endpoints.description: The devices rankings are tracked for -- desktop and mobile. Small reference list, but not incidental: RANKINGS DIFFER BETWEEN DEVICES, often substantially, so any position figure is device-specific and comparing across them without saying which is meaningless.

endpoints.name: Forecast
endpoints.description: SeoMonitor's projection of where a site's rankings and traffic are heading against its targets. Requires a site id. Modelled rather than measured -- useful as a target, not as evidence.

endpoints.name: Forecast by Date
endpoints.description: The same projection broken out by date rather than as a summary.

endpoints.name: Groups
endpoints.description: The keyword groups defined for one site. Requires a site id. Groups are how an account divides its keywords -- by product, by intent, by funnel stage -- and are the only dimension available for slicing rankings beyond individual keywords. What they mean is entirely account-specific.

endpoints.name: Group Details
endpoints.description: The performance of one keyword group over a date range: its keywords, their ranks and the group's aggregate figures. Requires the site id, group id and dates.

endpoints.name: All Group Details
endpoints.description: The same figures for every group of a site in one request. Requires the site id and dates. Far cheaper than looping groups, and the natural starting point for a whole-site breakdown.

endpoints.name: Keyword Data
endpoints.description: Per-keyword detail for one site over a range: search volume, difficulty, the tracked position and its movement. Requires the site id and dates. VOLUME IS THE MISSING HALF OF ANY RANK ANALYSIS -- a first position on a keyword nobody searches is worth less than a fifth on one they do, and rank alone cannot say which is which.

endpoints.name: Group Keyword Data
endpoints.description: The same per-keyword detail restricted to one group.

endpoints.name: Top Landing Pages
endpoints.description: The pages ranking for one keyword in the search results, with their positions. Requires the site id and keyword name. The link from a keyword to the page that actually earns it -- which matters because the page ranking is often not the one intended.

endpoints.name: Top Landing Pages by ID
endpoints.description: The same, addressed by keyword id rather than name. Safer where keyword text contains characters awkward in a URL.

endpoints.name: Organic Traffic Statistics
endpoints.description: Organic sessions for one site over a date range. Requires the site id and dates. The outcome measure rankings are a proxy for -- worth pairing, since positions can improve while traffic does not.

endpoints.name: Organic Traffic Statistics by Brand/Non-brand
endpoints.description: The same traffic SPLIT INTO BRANDED AND NON-BRANDED searches. Requires the site id and dates. The more honest measure of SEO effort: branded traffic follows marketing and word of mouth, non-branded is what optimisation actually won, and a total that mixes them credits SEO with demand it did not create.

endpoints.name: Ranks
endpoints.description: Keyword positions for one site over a date range -- the core SEO table. Requires the site id and dates. Note a keyword with no ranking in the top results returns a sentinel rather than a position, so averaging raw values without excluding those distorts the figure badly.

endpoints.name: Group Ranks
endpoints.description: The same rankings restricted to one keyword group. Requires the group id as well.

endpoints.name: Sites
endpoints.description: The sites tracked in the account, each with its id, domain and settings. Every other endpoint here needs a site id, so this is the first request.

endpoints.name: Visibility Score
endpoints.description: SeoMonitor's composite measure of how visible a site is for its tracked keywords, over a date range -- rankings weighted by search volume and expected click-through. Requires the site, group and dates. A single trend line where ranks are hundreds, and the usual answer to whether SEO is improving overall.
